name: newstarterbuddy
description: Joseph is your new starter buddy. He'll give you some pointers on where to start.

dialogue:
'Hey $player.'
'So you're our new Dogsbody! You'll be on my facilities team.'
'Our area with your desk is up on the top floor, tucked away in the far North-East corner (past the IS, Core, and Finance teams).'
'The job's pretty simple, you're here to make everyones lives easier. Fix stuff, fetch stuff, generally help people out.'
'If you haven't already noticed, your first vital job is to get the coffee machine working it's broken again.''Don't forget to get some coffee for yourself too, you'll need it!
'Sorting that out will likely encourage other people to start asking for your support so you can feel a little more useful by the end of the day!'

reward.message: Joseph gives you a big smile. 'Welcome to team Porta Rossa!'
